Beaver’s Story Bridge

FIRST and LAST found!

First the logs were gathered; last, Beaver crossed the finished bridge.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains first and last on the story picture itself: the questions are spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to say the answer out loud before tapping — the retelling is where comprehension really grows.

Prefer paper? The Beaver’s Story Bridge worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
